name: Electricity Access Rate
definition: Share of the national population with access to electricity.
formula: Population with electricity access ÷ total population × 100
disaggregation: Urban/rural where available
limitations: Baseline and actuals derived by dividing the Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report's "Actual # of people provided with electricity" (an absolute count, not a %) by a mid-year population estimate for each year — the Report itself gives no percentage directly. Population figures (237,527,782 for 2025; 242,431,832 for 2026; 2024 backed out from the stated ~2.04%/yr growth rate) were supplied for this reconciliation and have not been independently verified against a cited source in this platform. Previously tracked via SDG7 Tracking/IEA (61%, 2022) — that series is superseded here, not merged with it.
sourceInstitution: CDMU (Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report), population estimate as supplied
sourceReference: 0. Nigeria_Cycle 1 2026_Mission 300_Compact Progress Report_Worksheet_06_09_26.xlsx, "Nigeria Targets" sheet, divided by supplied population estimates
targetLabel: No approved level target — 9%/yr growth commitment

name: New Grid Connections (Annual)
definition: New direct grid connections added during the reporting period. Not a mini-grid connection.
formula: Current active registered grid customers minus comparable prior-period active registered customers
disaggregation: By Distribution Company
limitations: No single Compact target exists for the annual connection count — the 9% access-rate commitment must not be converted into a connection-count target.
sourceReference: NERC Quarterly Reports and Monthly Metering Factsheet
baselineLabel: Derived from NERC Q3 2025 metering data; net new connections tracked quarterly
targetLabel: Annual target to be confirmed; tracked against the 9% per annum access-rate commitment

name: Mini-Grid Customer Connections
definition: Active customer connections served by operational mini-grids.
formula: Sum of validated active household connections, reported separately from SME connections
disaggregation: Household and Micro/Small/Medium Enterprise connections reported separately
limitations: Business (SME) connections are tracked separately and must not be added to the household figure without a clear label.
sourceReference: REA DARES PMU; REA NEP completion report
baselineLabel: 107,519 household connections; 14,326 SME connections (NEP completion, 2025)
targetLabel: 750,000 household connections under DARES by 2030 (Nigeria National Energy Compact)

name: Solar Home Systems Deployed
definition: Eligible standalone Solar Home Systems sold or deployed under the DARES programme, tracked separately from the pre-2025 national cumulative stock.
formula: Count of validated systems deployed since the DARES programme baseline
disaggregation: Reporting-period and cumulative deployment distinguished
limitations: Distinct from the 2,930,000-system national cumulative stock reported in the NDC Stocktake (Sep 2024) — this tracks only additional DARES-programme deployment against the DARES-specific target.
sourceReference: REA DARES PMU; NDC Stocktake Report Sep 2024
baselineLabel: 0 at DARES programme tracking start (Jan 2025)
targetLabel: 2.75 million additional Solar Home Systems under DARES by 2030 (Nigeria National Energy Compact)

name: Available (Dispatched) Generation Capacity
definition: Actual generation capacity available for dispatch on the grid, net of constraints.
formula: Average of daily dispatched/available capacity over the reporting period
aggregation: National, by GenCo and fuel type
disaggregation: By GenCo; by fuel type; daily average aggregated to monthly and quarterly
limitations: Net of transmission and gas-supply constraints, so it understates installed capacity.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report; NISO Dispatch Tool Portal
baselineLabel: No fixed Compact baseline — tracked against IRP projections
targetLabel: No fixed Compact target; improvement tracked against IRP projections

name: Available Generation Capacity
definition: Generation capacity GenCos declare ready for dispatch, based on plant availability — before real-time transmission and gas-supply constraints reduce it to what is actually dispatched.
formula: Average of daily GenCo-declared available capacity over the reporting period
aggregation: National, by GenCo and fuel type
disaggregation: By GenCo; by fuel type; daily average aggregated to monthly and quarterly
limitations: Distinct from M300-P1-003 ("Available (Dispatched) Generation Capacity"), which is net of transmission and gas-supply constraints — this figure sits above that one and below M300-P1-002 (installed/nameplate capacity). The gap between this and M300-P1-003 is itself the story: how much of what GenCos say is ready never reaches the grid.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report; NISO Dispatch Tool Portal
baselineLabel: No fixed Compact baseline — tracked against IRP projections
targetLabel: No fixed Compact target; improvement tracked against IRP projections

name: Renewable Generation Share
definition: Percentage of total electricity generated from renewable sources (hydro, solar, wind).
formula: (Total renewable generation GWh ÷ total generation GWh) × 100
disaggregation: By renewable source (hydro, solar, wind)
limitations: Baseline and targets reconciled against the Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report ("Nigeria Targets", 06/09/26): its 26% baseline and 26.1% 2025/2026 actuals run above this KPI's earlier 22% hydro-only baseline, i.e. include renewable generation beyond hydro that this platform's own NERC/NISO source does not yet break out by source — solar and wind generation-mix data is not yet consistently reported here, so the true renewable share may differ materially once included. Renamed from "Renewable Energy Share in Generation Mix" to stay distinct from M300-P1-015 (installed capacity share), a different quantity per SE4ALL MRL guidance.
sourceInstitution: NISO / TCN / NERC; Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report (CDMU)
sourceReference: NERC Q3 2025 Report; IRENA Renewable Capacity Statistics 2025; 0. Nigeria_Cycle 1 2026_Mission 300_Compact Progress Report_Worksheet_06_09_26.xlsx, "Nigeria Targets" sheet
baselineLabel: 26% (Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report baseline)
targetLabel: 75% renewable energy share by 2030 (Nigeria National Energy Compact commitment, per GEAPP Reporting Nigeria Targets)

externalStandardAlignment.standard: SE4ALL MRL Guidance Note (confidential draft, Aug 2026)
inclusions: Electricity actually generated in the period, by source
exclusions: Installed/nameplate capacity — tracked separately as M300-P1-015, the CPR-canonical indicator
Solar and wind generation not yet consistently reported (see limitations)
assumptions: Current figure is hydro-only; excludes unreported solar/wind generation, so true renewable share is understated

targetPoints.label: 34% by 2030 (Cycle 1 2026 Compact Progress Report interim checkpoint — the 75% target above is the Compact's separate end-value commitment, beyond this report's 2030 column)

name: Available Transmission Transfer Capacity
definition: Transmission network capacity available to transfer generated power without constraint.
formula: As reported in TCN PIP and NERC Quarterly Report wheeling-capacity tables
disaggregation: By transmission corridor
limitations: Not yet in the confirmed registry pull — this indicator is shown with an illustrative placeholder value pending validated institutional data from TCN PIP monitoring. See docs/EMRC - M300 KPI Matrix v2-0 2026-06-29.xlsx.
sourceReference: TCN PIP; NERC Quarterly Report
baselineLabel: 3,200 MW baseline (2024, illustrative) — a primary bottleneck relative to 5,430 MW available generation (Q3 2025)
targetLabel: To match committed generation capacity additions under the IRP; specific MW targets defined in TCN PIP and MYTO capex plan

name: Metering Rate
definition: Total metered active customers as a share of total active registered customers.
formula: Total metered active customers ÷ total active registered customers × 100
aggregation: Weighted by active customers across Distribution Companies
disaggregation: By Distribution Company; by customer class where available
limitations: Depends on the accuracy of the active-customer register, which some DisCos update on a lag.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: Approx. 42% (2024 Compact baseline, derived from a 7,000,000-customer metering gap)
targetLabel: Metering gap closed by 2027: 1.5M meters (2025), 4M meters (2026), 1.5M meters (2027) — Nigeria National Energy Compact

name: ATC&C Loss Rate
definition: Aggregate Technical, Commercial and Collection losses as a share of energy input into the distribution network.
formula: (Energy input − energy billed and collected) ÷ energy input × 100
disaggregation: By Distribution Company
limitations: MYTO benchmark comparisons vary by DisCo service band; a single national figure masks wide DisCo-level variation.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: 42–47% range (2024 Compact baseline)
targetLabel: No single Compact target stated; tracked against MYTO benchmarks and DisCo PIP targets

name: DisCo Remittance to NBET/GenCos
definition: DisCo remittance to NBET and GenCos as a share of the Market Remittance Obligation (MRO).
formula: Amount remitted ÷ Market Remittance Obligation × 100
disaggregation: By Distribution Company
limitations: Reported quarterly by NERC; monthly figures interpolated between quarterly publications.
sourceReference: NERC Q3 2025 Report Table 11; NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: 95.21% remittance rate (Q3 2025, NERC Q3 2025 Report Table 11)
targetLabel: 100% Market Remittance Obligation (MRO) compliance (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 3 target)

name: Subsidy / Tariff Shortfall
definition: Gap between cost-reflective tariff revenue requirement and actual tariff revenue collected, met by federal subsidy.
formula: Cost-reflective revenue requirement − actual tariff revenue collected
disaggregation: Not currently disaggregated by DisCo in published reports
limitations: Subject to revision pending the approved subsidy framework and social tariff policy.
sourceReference: NERC / sector estimate referenced in Data Requirement Report
baselineLabel: Approx. NGN 2.2 trillion / USD 1.5 billion (2024 Compact estimate)
targetLabel: Reduce toward zero tariff shortfall by 2027 under the cost-reflective tariff pathway

name: Total Metered Customers
definition: Cumulative number of electricity end-users with a functioning meter installed by a Distribution Company.
formula: Count of active registered customers with a functioning meter
disaggregation: By Distribution Company (11 DisCos); by meter type
limitations: Depends on the accuracy of each DisCo’s active-customer register, updated on a lag.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: No separate Compact baseline — tracked jointly with the metering gap
targetLabel: Metering gap closed by 2027: 1.5M meters (2025), 4M meters (2026), 1.5M meters (2027) — Nigeria National Energy Compact

name: Total Unmetered Customers
definition: Cumulative number of registered electricity customers without a functioning meter.
formula: Total active registered customers − total metered customers
disaggregation: By Distribution Company (11 DisCos)
limitations: Derived from NERC published totals rather than a direct DisCo-level count.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: No separate Compact baseline — tracked jointly with the metering gap
targetLabel: Zero unmetered active customers by end 2027 (Nigeria National Energy Compact metering target)

name: Metering Gap
definition: Difference between total registered customers and metered customers.
formula: Total active registered customers − total metered customers
disaggregation: By Distribution Company (11 DisCos)
limitations: Moves with both connection growth and metering rollout, so is not a pure metering-progress measure.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: 7,000,000-customer metering gap (2024 Compact baseline)
targetLabel: 100% metering density across all 11 DisCos by end 2027 (Nigeria National Energy Compact)

name: DisCo Revenue Collection
definition: Total customer cash revenue actually collected by DisCos during the reporting period, excluding subsidies, grants and financing proceeds.
formula: Sum of customer cash revenue collected by Distribution Companies
disaggregation: By Distribution Company; by customer class where available
limitations: Excludes subsidy payments and tariff-shortfall compensation by design — not a full utility cash-flow measure.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: No fixed Compact target — tracked alongside collection efficiency and remittance performance
targetLabel: No fixed Compact target; monitored alongside collection efficiency, remittance and tariff shortfall

name: DisCo Collection Efficiency
definition: Revenue collected by DisCos as a percentage of total revenue invoiced to customers.
formula: Revenue collected ÷ revenue billed × 100
aggregation: National weighted average, by Distribution Company
disaggregation: By Distribution Company
limitations: Reported figures for the same quarter have varied slightly between NERC publications (74–79%); the higher, most recently confirmed figure is shown.
sourceReference: NERC Q4 2025 Report
baselineLabel: No fixed Compact baseline stated
targetLabel: 100% collection efficiency (cost-reflective utility target under Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 3)

name: Average End-User Tariff
definition: Weighted average tariff charged to electricity end-users across all customer bands.
formula: Customer-population-weighted average of approved tariff rates across service bands
aggregation: National, weighted by customer population across service bands
disaggregation: By service band (A–E); by Distribution Company
limitations: A national weighted average masks wide variation across service bands and DisCos.
sourceReference: NERC MYTO Tariff Orders
baselineLabel: No separate Compact baseline stated
targetLabel: Cost-reflective tariff for all DisCo service bands by 2027 (Nigeria National Energy Compact commitment)

name: Current Cost-Reflective Tariff
definition: The current NERC-approved or calculated cost-reflective tariff required to recover efficient electricity supply costs.
formula: NERC MYTO cost-reflective tariff determination, per service band
aggregation: National, by service band, Distribution Company and customer class
disaggregation: By service band (A–E); by Distribution Company
limitations: Represents the regulator’s cost-reflective determination, not the tariff actually charged to most customers.
sourceReference: NERC MYTO Tariff Orders
baselineLabel: No separate Compact baseline stated
targetLabel: Cost-reflective tariff for all DisCo service bands by 2027 (Nigeria National Energy Compact commitment)

name: DISREP / PSRP DLI Milestones Achieved
definition: Number and percentage of agreed Disbursement-Linked Indicators met by the Federal Government under the IDA-funded Power Sector Recovery Programme and DISREP reform operations.
formula: DLIs achieved ÷ total DLIs defined in the PSRP/DISREP financing agreements × 100
disaggregation: By programme; by DLI number
limitations: Verified only through IDA Implementation Status Reports, which publish on a lag.
sourceReference: IDA Implementation Status Reports for PSRP (P164001) and DISREP (P172891)
baselineLabel: DLIs as defined in the PSRP (P164001) and DISREP (P172891) financing agreements
targetLabel: 100% of agreed DLIs achieved by programme close dates

name: PMI Metering Milestones Achieved
definition: Number and percentage of Presidential Metering Initiative milestones achieved, including procurement, delivery, installation and financing milestones.
formula: PMI milestones achieved ÷ total PMI milestones due in the reporting period × 100
disaggregation: By Distribution Company; by state; by procurement stage
limitations: Depends on structured updates from the PMI Secretariat, SGDL, NERC and DisCos, not yet standardised.
sourceReference: PMI programme reports; NERC Monthly Metering Factsheet
baselineLabel: To be confirmed from PMI/SGDL programme commencement records
targetLabel: Contribute to closing the national metering gap by 2027 (1.5M meters in 2025, 4M in 2026, 1.5M in 2027)

name: DARES Programme Milestones Achieved
definition: Number and percentage of DARES programme milestones achieved across mini-grids, Solar Home Systems, technical assistance and developer pipeline.
formula: DARES milestones achieved ÷ total DARES milestones due in the reporting period × 100
disaggregation: By component; by state; by milestone status
limitations: Sourced from the DARES PMU tracker and World Bank ISRs, which publish on a lag.
sourceReference: DARES PMU progress reports; World Bank Implementation Status Reports
baselineLabel: To be validated from the DARES PMU programme tracker
targetLabel: 100% of due DARES milestones achieved against programme schedule

name: Average Daily Supply Availability
definition: Average number of hours of electricity supply delivered to Band A customers per day across DisCo franchise areas.
formula: Average hours of supply per day per DisCo, derived from feeder-level outage-management data
aggregation: National, by Distribution Company and service band
disaggregation: By Distribution Company (11 DisCos); by feeder; rural vs urban where available
limitations: National figure spans a wide 12–18 hour/day range across DisCos; the higher end of the reported range is shown.
sourceReference: NERC Quarterly Report, supply hours section
baselineLabel: No separate Compact baseline stated
targetLabel: Minimum 20 hours/day supply for Band A customers (NERC service band commitment)

name: PIP Implementation Progress
definition: Percentage completion of approved Performance Improvement Plan milestones by each Distribution Company and TCN against the NERC-approved PIP schedule.
formula: PIP milestones achieved in the reporting period ÷ total PIP milestones due × 100
aggregation: National, by Distribution Company and TCN
disaggregation: By Distribution Company (11 DisCos) and TCN; by PIP category
limitations: Progress is highly variable across DisCos; a single national figure is not yet extracted.
sourceReference: NERC PIP monitoring reports
baselineLabel: To be extracted from NERC PIP Monitoring Unit quarterly assessments
targetLabel: 100% of approved PIP milestones achieved by all DisCos and TCN within NERC-mandated timelines

disaggregation: National aggregate; by implementation stage (adopted, under revision, operationalised for procurement); state-level IRP where applicable
limitations: Not yet in the confirmed registry pull — this indicator is shown with an illustrative placeholder value pending validated institutional data. See docs/EMRC - M300 KPI Matrix v2-0 2026-06-29.xlsx.
sourceReference: Approved IRP documents; FMoP implementation records
baselineLabel: IRP not fully operationalised as of Jan 2025; IRP development and adoption is Compact Pillar 1 action item
targetLabel: IRP fully operationalised as the basis for all generation procurement and system expansion under M300 Compact timeline (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 1 commitment)

name: Competitive Generation Procurement Framework Approved
definition: Status of approval of a policy and regulatory framework enabling competitive, transparent procurement of new generation capacity including Independent Power Producers (IPPs), ensuring bankable offtake arrangements and investor confidence
formula: Binary milestone indicator: "Yes" once NERC has approved a competitive generation procurement regulation consistent with the Electricity Act 2023 and Compact commitments. Date of approval and first procurement round launch recorded
disaggregation: National; by procurement stage (framework approved, first tender launched, first contract awarded); by technology type
limitations: Not yet in the confirmed registry pull — this indicator is shown with an illustrative placeholder value pending validated institutional data. See docs/EMRC - M300 KPI Matrix v2-0 2026-06-29.xlsx.
sourceReference: NERC orders and generation procurement regulations
baselineLabel: Competitive procurement framework not yet formally approved under Electricity Act 2023 as of Jan 2025
targetLabel: Competitive generation procurement framework approved and first competitive round launched within Compact Action Plan timeline (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 1 commitment)

name: Share of Energy Traded Under Bilateral Contracts
definition: Percentage of total electricity market energy transacted directly between generators (GenCos) and distribution companies (DisCos) or eligible large buyers under NERC-approved bilateral power purchase agreements, as a measure of market liberalisation progress beyond the transitional single-buyer model
formula: Derived: (Total energy MWh transacted under bilateral contracts / Total market energy MWh transacted) x 100. Sourced from Market Operator quarterly settlement data and NERC-registered bilateral contract volumes
disaggregation: By GenCo; by DisCo or eligible buyer; by contract type (bilateral vs transitional single-buyer); national aggregate percentage
limitations: Not yet in the confirmed registry pull — this indicator is shown with an illustrative placeholder value pending validated institutional data. See docs/EMRC - M300 KPI Matrix v2-0 2026-06-29.xlsx.
sourceReference: Market Operator settlement records and billing data
baselineLabel: 0% bilateral trading as of Jan 2025 (all energy transacted through transitional NBET single-buyer model); market reform is Compact Pillar 1 commitment
targetLabel: Progressive increase in bilateral contract share aligned with Compact market reform milestones; target percentage to be defined in approved market transition roadmap (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 1 commitment)

name: Transmission Network Expansion Completed
definition: New transmission lines (km) and substations (MVA) completed, energised and commissioned during the reporting period under TCN Performance Improvement Plan and Compact-linked capital investment programme
formula: Cumulative count of km of new transmission lines and MVA of new substation capacity commissioned and energised in the reporting period as certified by TCN engineering division and cross-validated with NERC PIP monitoring reports
disaggregation: By transmission line (km, voltage class); by substation (MVA, location); by geopolitical zone; by funding source (FGN, IDA, AfDB)
limitations: Not yet in the confirmed registry pull — this indicator is shown with an illustrative placeholder value pending validated institutional data. See docs/EMRC - M300 KPI Matrix v2-0 2026-06-29.xlsx.
sourceReference: TCN project implementation and commissioning reports
baselineLabel: TCN PIP implementation ongoing; baseline capacity additions from PIP commencement date to be extracted from TCN project records
targetLabel: TCN PIP capital investment targets as defined in NERC-approved MYTO regulatory period and M300 Compact transmission expansion commitments (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 1)

name: Distribution Network Expansion Completed

disaggregation: By DisCo (11 DisCos); by distribution voltage level; by project type (feeder extension, transformer upgrade, network rehabilitation); by state

baselineLabel: DisCo PIP investments ongoing; aggregate baseline network expansion data to be extracted from NERC Q3/Q4 2025 quarterly reports and DisCo PIP monitoring data
targetLabel: DisCo PIP capital investment targets as defined in NERC MYTO regulatory period and DISREP programme commitments; specific annual targets per DisCo in approved PIPs (Nigeria National Energy Compact Pillar 1)
